about: A file system of Markdown pages for teams and AI agents.

prs.title: Spreadsheet imports keep ZIP codes, phone numbers and long IDs
prs.broken: Imports turned values like ZIP codes and phone numbers into numbers, dropping leading zeros. Long IDs lost digits, so two different records could overwrite each other.
prs.changed: Values with a leading zero, and IDs too long to store as numbers, now stay as text.
prs.matters: Imported data stays exactly as it was, and no records are lost.

prs.title: CSV files saved by Excel import with the right column names
prs.broken: Excel's CSV files start with a hidden mark that stuck to the first column name. Pages got the wrong names and searches on that column found nothing.
prs.changed: The importer now removes the hidden mark before reading the file.
prs.matters: Spreadsheets from Excel import cleanly and can be searched.
